name: Tank platoon
description: Three medium tanks: the platoon most armies of the war fought in.

name: Light tank platoon
description: Three light tanks: fast, thin, and quick to see.

name: Heavy tank section
description: Two heavy tanks, fielded in pairs because there were never many.

name: Tank destroyer section
description: Two tank destroyers: a long gun and a hull that must turn to lay it.

name: Reconnaissance section
description: Two scout cars, to find the enemy and not to fight him.

name: Mechanised platoon
description: Four carriers, a rifle squad in each.

name: Halftrack platoon
description: Three halftracks, a rifle squad in each.
